adaptations: Base and stylesheet destinations are local. Every script is removed.
Image pixels are replaced with blank SVGs at the exact declared intrinsic dimensions. All image declarations and chemical text in the source remain untouched.
The fixed render adds only the same overflow-wrap:anywhere span whose exact source change is verified through the real Worker.
No Wikipedia requests, screenshots, clipboard operations or publishing occur.
scope: Portable browser geometry regression of the Firefox long-InChI minimum-width defect, not a screenshot or full visual audit.
